title: lepidium draba subsp. eudraba
intro: Lepidium draba subsp. eudraba, commonly known as wild cress or desert cress, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It is used for its health benefits, which include its potential to help in the management of various health conditions, such as arthritis, due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Lepidium draba subsp. eudraba include its ability to reduce inflammation and oxidative stress, as well as its potential to act as an antioxidant. Bioactive constituents of the plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
